test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A train started with 450 passengers. At the first stop, (1)/(9) of them got down and 20 new passengers got in. At the second stop, (1)/(6) of the passengers then existing got down and 19 new passengers boarded. With how many passengers did the train arrive at the third stop?
solution:
**Given:**

Total passenger at the beginning = 450

**Concept used:**

Final = Initial + inclusion or - exclusion

**Calculation:**

Passenger after 1st stop = 450 × 8/9 + 20

⇒ 420

Passenger after 2nd stop = 420 × 5/6 + 19

⇒ 369

**∴ 369 passenger were there when train arraived at the third stop.**
